# 1 Enoch Chapter 8 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Book of the Watchers

---

**1** And Azazel taught men to make swords and daggers and shields and breastplates, and he revealed to them the metals of the earth and the art of working them; and bracelets and ornaments, and the use of antimony, and the beautifying of the eyelids, and all kinds of precious stones, and all coloring dyes.

**2** And there arose much godlessness, and they committed fornication and were led astray and became corrupt in all their ways. Semyaza taught sorcery and the cutting of roots; Armaros the dissolution of sorcery; Baraqel astrology; Kokabel the knowledge of the constellations; Ezeqel the knowledge of the clouds;

**3** Araqiel the signs of the earth; Shamsiel the signs of the sun; and Sariel the course of the moon. And as men perished, their cry ascended to heaven.

**4** And then Michael, Uriel, Raphael, and Gabriel looked down from the sanctuary of heaven and saw all the blood being shed on the earth and all the lawlessness being done on the earth.

---

*LOGOS notes: Chapter 8 presents two strands of angelic sin: Azazel's revelation of military technology and cosmetics (v. 1) and the broader catalog of Watchers who taught forbidden cosmic knowledge (vv. 2–3). The names of the teaching Watchers and their domains are preserved with transliterations consistent with the Ge'ez and Aramaic tradition. V. 4 transitions into the divine council scene of ch. 9.*
